newsitem.title: MEXICO: MASECA AGREES TO BUY 200,000 TONNES CORN.
newsitem.headline: MASECA AGREES TO BUY 200,000 TONNES CORN.

text.p: Grupo Maseca signed a contract to buy 200,000 tonnes of corn from growers in Jalisco state's next crop, the company said.
In a statement, the company said it "committed to use the corn harvested in Jalisco." It did not specify the purchase price.
The contract is part of a program to motivate producers in Jalisco, Nayarit, Baja California, Yucatan, Campeche and Veracruz states with plans to extend to Tamaulipas state, the company said.

"Since three years ago Grupo Maseca has offered specialized aid and a purchase guarantee to different corn producers, through which it boosts the profitability of the crops," Maseca said in the statement.
